title.narrative: Strengthening food control and phytosanitary capacities and governance

description.narrative: This project will achieve the following results:Improved common understanding of the internationally recognized methodology for assessing the national food control system across countries and improvement of the FAO/WHO food control system assessment tool through maintenance and upgrade. Comprehensive assessments of 9 national food control systems through the use of FAO/WHO National Food Control System Assessment Tool.Comprehensive assessment of the Phytosanitary systems in 9 target countries.
